PLAN "12-Week Bodyweight Strength Foundation"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Build full-body bodyweight strength"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 Foundation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Full Body A":
        warmup:
          jumping_jack 2x30
          arm_circles 2x15
          cat_cow 2x10
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 3x6..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          split_squat 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          inverted_row 3x6..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x20 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 60s
          hamstring_stretch 60s
          chest_stretch 60s
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Full Body B":
        warmup:
          jumping_jack 2x30
          leg_swings 2x10
          hip_circles 2x10
        main straight_sets:
          pull_up 3x3..5 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          squat 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dip 3x4..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          reverse_lunge 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dead_bug 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 60s
          lat_stretch 60s
          shoulder_stretch 60s
      DAY Friday training 40m "Full Body C":
        warmup:
          marching 2x30
          arm_circles 2x15
          cat_cow 2x10
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 4x5..8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          chin_up 3x3..5 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          goblet_squat 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          back_extension 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds

          pigeon_pose 60s
